title: Energy API image
summary: A slim Python image: dependencies installed first so code changes rebuild fast, the app runs as a non-root user on port 8080 with a health check, reading the published extract from a mounted /data folder.

steps.note: A separate layer: changing app.py does not reinstall them.

steps.note: The extract is mounted, not baked into the image.
